about.title: About M.N. Desai Petrol Pump
about.description: M N Desai company was established in 1961. During that time one can hardly find a petrol pump on road. M N Desai was dealing in Crude Oil during 1960s. M N Desai was the Petrol Pump between Ahmedabad Bagodra Road during 1970s and 1980s.
